_**Agent (default)**_

Implemented a local Markdown exporter for your CMS blog posts.

### What I changed

- Added `scripts/export-contentful-blog-to-markdown.mjs`
- Added npm script in `package.json`:
  - `export:blog` → `node scripts/export-contentful-blog-to-markdown.mjs`

### How the exporter works

- Fetches posts from Contentful GraphQL in pages (`limit=100`).
- Writes one file per post to `content/blog/<slug>.md`.
- Adds frontmatter fields:
  - `title`
  - `slug`
  - `date`
  - `tagLine`
  - `description`
  - `contentfulId`
- Uses post `body` as Markdown content.

### Env vars it accepts

The script supports either direct GraphQL URL or derived URL:

- URL source:
  - `CONTENTFUL_GRAPHQL_API_URL`
  - **or** `CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID` (with optional `CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENT`, default `master`)
- Token source:
  - `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_API_ACCESS_TOKEN`
  - **or** `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_API_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`

### Why export did not run yet

Your current shell has no Contentful env vars set, so runtime failed with missing variables.

### Run it locally

```bash
export CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID="your_space_id"
export CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENT="master"
export CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_API_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="your_token"
npm run export:blog
```

or with explicit URL:

```bash
export CONTENTFUL_GRAPHQL_API_URL="https://graphql.contentful.com/content/v1/spaces/<space>/environments/<env>"
export CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_API_ACCESS_TOKEN="your_token"
npm run export:blog
```

Output path: `content/blog`.
